producer_gate_lie.title: Producer's Keycard swipe
producer_gate_lie.description: Producer claimed he spent the entire broadcast in the control room and never swiped keycard, but Studio A keycard logs trace swipe at 10:02 PM.

chief_power_lie.title: Chief's Power Cut Claim
chief_power_lie.description: Security Chief claimed power grid failure shut cameras, but server logs prove station power never failed—someone manually disabled feeds.

politician_garage_lie.title: Politician's Building Entry
politician_garage_lie.description: Politician claimed he was miles away from the station, but a parking ticket receipt stub registers his vehicle entering the garage at 9:55 PM.

journalist_mug_fingerprint.title: Journalist's Coffee Swipe
journalist_mug_fingerprint.description: Fellow journalist claimed he never met Elena tonight, but his fresh fingerprints are mapped on her shattered coffee mug.
